prompt: list me 20 countries that might declare independence in the next 10 years
judge_reasoning: All candidates attempt to list 20 secession/independence candidates, but several include items that are clearly not “countries”/territories likely to declare independence (e.g., parties or already-independent entities). Candidate 1 provides the most coherent, place-focused list with the fewest obvious category errors and keeps the items mostly consistent with the prompt’s intent. Candidate 2 is also largely on-task but includes a few shakier inclusions (e.g., conditional/ambiguous cases and some that are more about status/recognition than independence). Candidates 3 and 4 have more significant misalignments (such as “Scottish National Party” and items like “South Sudan”/“South West Africa” that are already independent, plus non-place entries).
